body: I can't seem to shake the feeling that someone left these strange tracks here. The way they’ve blended into the grass almost seamlessly—like nature had given them a second life—makes me uneasy. But there’s also an inexplicable thrill in knowing I might be witnessing something extraordinary. Sooner or later, one of us has to explain why these footprints matter, so I’m determined to find out what led to this trail.
